scope: Additive TH18 regular Dragon L1-L13 direct-parent baseline; unquantified splash and flight contracts remain disabled.

sources.title: Dragon — Clash of Clans
sources.limitations: Reports L1-L13 HP/DPS, 20 housing, 1.25-second cadence, 2.5 range and ground/air target eligibility. It says Dragon splash reaches neighbours but does not quantify splash radius, damage split, target selection, projectile flight, collision, animation or fixed-tick order.

sources.title: The State of Gameplay and What’s Ahead
sources.limitations: Confirms Dragon was among troops due for additional upgrades, but gives no resulting numeric table or combat geometry.

range_tiles.note: The current build-pinned table supersedes the immutable raw 3-tile value.

support.note: The existing generic flying direct-parent path is now source-bounded through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL. No splash geometry is inferred.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only direct parent with an immutable raw 3-tile range and generic direct damage.
changed_values.replacement: The L1-L13 direct parent is executable at a current reported 2.5-tile range through shared adapters; the unquantified splash remains absent.
changed_values.justification: The current table supplies the parent contract and range but no splash or projectile metrics.

known_uncertainties: No consulted source gives splash radius, damage allocation, eligible secondary victims, obstruction, targeting order, projectile flight, collision, target loss, first-hit delay or same-tick ordering.
No consulted source verifies exact flight path, movement interpolation, attack animation, entity footprint or visual asset tier.
The primary March announcement confirms future Dragon upgrades without numeric results; all exact values are secondary build-pinned.
conclusion: Dragon L1-L13 is executable as a source-bounded flying direct parent through Core, Headless, Viewer and RL with a 2.5-tile range. Its published qualitative splash is intentionally not approximated.
